window.main.title: Fate Compass
window.config.title: Fate Compass Settings
list.name: FATE
list.empty: No FATEs active in this zone.
button.flag.tooltip: Place the map flag on this FATE. Then type <flag> in chat and send it.
button.engage.tooltip: Get combat ready right now: dismount, level sync, tank stance. The same thing the automation does, only once and on your say-so.
button.automation.tooltip: On entering a FATE, dismount, sync your level, and put the tank stance up.
button.announce.tooltip: Writes a ready-made line into your chat box whenever a new FATE takes the lead, and puts the map flag on it. Nothing is sent: you press enter.
button.announce.channel.tooltip: Channel for the line ({0}). Only while your chat box is empty.
setting.allowAnnounce: Allow writing the next FATE into the chat box
setting.allowAnnounce.help: Makes the feature available at all. Its switch and channel picker then appear in the bottom bar of the main window.
statusBar.tooltip: Left click: open the FATE list. Right click: toggle automatic preparation.
setting.showStatusBar: Show a button next to the minimap
setting.showStatusBar.help: Appears in the server info bar. Saves typing a command.
setting.showMinimapButton: Show an icon on the minimap
setting.showMinimapButton.help: Sits against the minimap's edge like the weather glyph. Left click opens, right click toggles the automation.
placement.hint: Drag the icon to wherever you want it.
setting.showCompass: Show a direction needle under each target
setting.showCompass.help: A small needle that turns with your facing and points at the target. Up means straight ahead, green means on course. It shows the straight line, not a walkable route. It becomes a ring once you have arrived.
setting.showRankMarkers: Number the top FATEs on the map
setting.showRankMarkers.help: Places the game's own markers on the map and minimap, so the running order is visible there.
route.returnFirst: Casts Return to get you back to camp. The rest of the way is the camp travel menu.
route.tooLate: Too late, it ends before you arrive
gemstones.label: Bicolor gemstones: {0} of {1}
gemstones.full: Gemstone purse is full. Further FATE rewards are lost.
sharedFate.progress: {0}: {1}, {2}/{3} FATEs, {4} to go for the next rank
sharedFate.noData: FATE progress not read yet. Open the game's FATE progress window once.
sharedFate.age: Read {0} ago. Refreshes whenever you open that window.
sharedFate.heading: FATE progress {0}:
setting.trackSharedFate.help: Read whenever you open the game's FATE progress window. Click through its tabs to capture every zone.
history.notEnoughData: Not enough sightings for an estimate yet.
hint.ridingMapMissing: Riding map not bought here ({0}). It would make you faster in this zone.
setting.confirmReturnPrompt.help: Pressing the travel button in Eureka, Bozja or the Crescent casts Return, and the game then asks whether you meant it. That one prompt is answered with yes. Only that one, only in the seconds after your button press, and only once. Every other yes/no prompt is left alone.
settings.steps.hint: Only runs while the FATE automation above is switched on.
settings.mapMarkers.hint: Puts the running order onto the map and the minimap.
settings.weights.hint: How much each factor counts. The values are relative to each other.
setting.enabled.help: Master switch. When off, nothing is observed and nothing is sent.
setting.autoEngage: Prepare automatically on entering a FATE
setting.autoEngage.help: Off by default. When off, use the Prepare button or the /fate engage command.
setting.autoRemount.help: Skipped while in combat or while casting.
setting.travelSpeed.exploratory: Travel speed in Eureka, Bozja, and the Crescent (riding map bought)
setting.travelSpeed.exploratorySlow: The same zones without the riding map
setting.returnOverhead: Cost of a journey in an exploratory zone (seconds)
setting.showNotification: Show a pop-up for a new FATE
setting.showNotification.help: Shows a note in the corner of the screen for a few seconds whenever a FATE appears.
setting.soundOnNewFate: Play a sound for a new FATE
setting.notifyOnlyIncluded: Only notify for FATEs that pass the filter
setting.notifyDistance: Maximum notification distance (0 means no limit)
setting.gemstoneHeadroom: Warn when this much room is left
setting.typeFlagIntoChat: Type <flag> into the chat box when flagging
setting.typeFlagIntoChat.help: Only typed, never sent. The channel and the send stay yours.
command.help: /fate opens the window, /fate cfg the settings, /fate engage prepares now, /fate auto on|off|toggle switches the automatic trigger, /fate news shows what changed.
window.news.title: What's new
button.news.tooltip: Shows what changed in this version and the ones before it.
button.news.tooltip.unseen: Version {0} brings changes you have not read yet.
news.empty: No release notes in this language yet.
setting.showNewsOnUpdate.help: Opens the window once after an update, showing what that version brought. Not on a first installation, and never twice.
